The managing director says the numbers "have not disappointed." Bradda Head Lithium Ltd (AIM:BHL) has reported surface assays of up to 3.9% lithium oxide at its Whistlejacket project in Arizona. It's now kicking off its first drilling programme there. Helium One Global Ltd (AIM:HE1, FRA:9K3) has extended its helium offtake deal at Galactica-Pegasus in Colorado through to March 2027.
